place_fields.summary: Dense protected forest sanctuary centered on the Kali River, known for wildlife viewing, trekking, birdwatching and river activities.

planning_attributes.description: A protected wildlife landscape in Uttara Kannada and part of the Kali Tiger Reserve.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Dandeli Wildlife Sanctuary forms part of the Dandeli-Anshi protected area complex, unified under the tiger reserve in 2007.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Dandeli is road-connected; Alnavar Junction is the nearest railway connection and Hubballi/Belagavi provide air access.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Forest activities and safaris are regulated; follow forest permissions and designated activity areas.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Use authorized guides/operators, follow wildlife-safety rules, and avoid unsafe river conditions during heavy rain.
planning_attributes.notes: Best suited to a full-day wildlife/adventure visit; official tourism sources highlight safari, trekking, birdwatching and Kali River activities.

place_fields.summary: A dense Western Ghats sanctuary around the Brahmagiri Hills, with evergreen forests, streams, wildlife, waterfalls and trekking routes.

planning_attributes.description: A biodiversity-rich sanctuary in Kodagu with trekking, birding and waterfall trails.
planning_attributes.elevation_or_height: 181 sq km approx.; Brahmagiri peak 1,608 m
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Declared a wildlife sanctuary in 1974 and associated with the sacred Brahmagiri Hill and Thirunelli Temple.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Accessible by road via Virajpet/Gonikoppal; Srimangala is the nearest town cited by Karnataka Tourism.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Trekking permits are required; access is subject to forest rules.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Carry adequate water, use proper trekking footwear and follow forest guidance; monsoon conditions can make trails hazardous.
planning_attributes.notes: The Brahmagiri trek is described by Karnataka Tourism as approximately 15 km and moderate difficulty.

place_fields.summary: Goa's largest wildlife sanctuary, a heavily forested Western Ghats landscape with hiking trails, waterfalls and diverse flora and fauna.

planning_attributes.description: A protected sanctuary near Mollem containing the Mollem National Park core area and attractions including Dudhsagar waterfall.
planning_attributes.legend_or_history: Originally Mollem Game Sanctuary; declared a wildlife sanctuary in 1969. Its 107 sq km core became Mollem National Park in 1978.
planning_attributes.how_to_reach: Located near Mollem on Goa's eastern border, about 54 km from Panaji; road and rail access are available.
planning_attributes.access_restrictions: Open 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM daily; entry fees apply and access to activities follows sanctuary rules.
planning_attributes.safety_notes: Stay on designated trails, respect wildlife, and take extra care around waterfalls and forest terrain.
planning_attributes.notes: The sanctuary is especially popular October–March, while monsoon brings fuller waterfalls but wetter conditions.
